global QC stabilization theorem are those of ../graded_stabilization/.
The eight acoustic charges and completed covariance capacity are those
of ../acoustic_capacity/. These governing premises are not replaced by
a numerical proposal. receive.py --replay-stabilization reconstructs
and checks the 13,524 strictly shifted Bernstein matrices again.

The new conclusions concern EVERY actual periodic gradient in L4:

 (i) F has a strictly positive Jensen gap at every finite mean whenever
